title: Arithmetic

inlines.v: ARITH'METIC, noun [Gr. to number, the art of numbering, from number; from number, rhythm, order, agreement.] The science of numbers, or the art of computation. The various operations of arithmetic are performed by addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
